Class store_order_values

java.lang.Object
controller.store_order_values
public class store_order_values extends Object
A class that collects some of the values needed to add an entry into the order history table in database.

This includes the:

  • Drink name
  • Topping name
  • Quantity of the drink
  • Size of the drink
  • Subtotal of the individual drink
  • Subtotal of the row entry (Especially if quantity is more than 1)

Will be used in the finish order window to collect all the data needed (combined with customer phone number, payment type, time, and server name) for the order history table.
